caption:
Claude Code usage limits doubled on May 6, 2026. If you use it to build workflows, automate client tasks, or generate reports—you can do twice as much now before hitting a ceiling.

The catch: the free tier still maxes out immediately. Pro is worth the $20/month if you're building anything that takes more than a few turns.

Save this if you're thinking about building something inside Claude for your business, or share it with a developer who is.

slides.sub: Usage limits doubled on all paid plans.

body.t: on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise. You can do roughly twice as much work before the limiter hits in a single session.
Multi-step automations, client report generators, internal tools, proposal builders. Anything that takes 10+ turns now takes 20 before the ceiling. You still pay the same $20/month (Pro) or higher.
